newsitem.title: ESTONIA: MOST STOCKS SLIGHTLY HIGHER IN SOLID TRADE.
newsitem.headline: MOST STOCKS SLIGHTLY HIGHER IN SOLID TRADE.

text.p: Prices on the Estonian bourse
on Thursday were slightly higher, but selling pressure was
holding some stocks stable despite high volumes, dealers said.
The Talse increased by 0.01 percent to close on 259.15 with
79.6 million kroons of shares traded on the main list.
"Hansapank moved higher and other stocks followed but
selling pressure kept Uhispank and Tallinna Pank
stable despite good volumes," one senior trader said.
"The market will come off slightly on Friday," he added.
Total market capitalisation was stable at 13.97 billion
kroons compared to Wednesday's 13.97 billion kroons.
Uhispank was the most active with stock on turnover of 18.7
million kroons to lose 1.08 kroons to finish on 56.25 kroons.
"Uhispank's price makes it easy to get into for investors,
and we are seeing a lot of market maker activity in the stock,"
the trader said.
"But the constant selling pressure holds the price steady
and there is still a good supply of stock avalible," he said.
Hansapank turned over 18 million kroons of shares to end
0.20 kroons higher on 268.20 kroons after recording highs of
273.22 during the day.
Hoiupank saw a trade of 17.1 million of kroons to
be 1.05 kroons higher to close on 130.00 kroons.
On the over-the-counter market, total trade was 6.9 million
kroons of shares with diviersified industrialist Norma
the most active stock.
Norma turned over 1.9 million kroons of shares to 0.07
kroons higher for a close on 74.90 kroons.
